name: Clicky Clacky Tower
desc:
Welcome to Clicky Clacky Tower!🎧
Can you climb a leaderboard made of clicky keycaps with every step going creamy click?
Relax and enjoy the ASMR sound of clicky keyboard keys.
But be careful… one mistype and you’ll be back at the bottom of the leaderboard, looking like you're starting fresh.

🎧 Built for ASMR: soft sounds, smooth physics, satisfying clicks
